name: Volcanic & aviation ash
value: Mayon at Level 3; no red aviation codes
summary: Mayon raised to Alert Level 3 on 30 Oct; no red aviation codes or large eruptions reported
state: The Philippines raised Mayon to Alert Level 3 on 30 Oct after a moderately explosive eruption sent ash about 3 km above the crater (Ground News, citing Phivolcs). The weekly report for 22–28 Oct listed no red aviation codes and no plume above 10 km; Sheveluch, Great Sitkin and Whakaari stayed at Orange, long-running states rather than new events (The Watchers). GDACS listed no volcano alerts on 8 Nov, and no VEI 4+ eruption or major ash closure was found as of 8 Nov.
for_you: Airlines were advised to avoid flying near Mayon's summit. Travellers to the Philippines can check FCDO travel advice and local Phivolcs notices. No major airspace closures from ash were found as of 8 Nov.
rubric_hit: Normal: no aviation colour code red and no large eruption (highest plume 5.6 km in 22–28 Oct report; Mayon about 3 km above crater)
